item.name: Get ERC20 token transfers by wallet address

request.name: Get ERC20 token transfers by wallet address

description.content: Get all ERC20 token transfers for a given wallet address, sorted by block number (newest first).

query.description:
The minimum block number from which to get the transactions
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

The maximum block number from which to get the transactions.
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.

The start date from which to get the transactions (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

Get the transactions up to this date (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.
List of contract addresses of transfers
List of contract addresses of transfers
The desired page size of the result.
The order of the result, in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC)
The cursor returned in the previous response (used for getting the next page).

response.name: Returns a collection of token transactions.

item.name: Get ERC20 token transfers by contract address

request.name: Get ERC20 token transfers by contract address

description.content: Get all ERC20 token transfers for a contract, ordered by block number (newest first).

query.description:
The minimum block number from which to get the transfers
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

The maximum block number from which to get the transfers.
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.

The start date from which to get the transfers (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'from_block' or 'from_date'
* If 'from_date' and 'from_block' are provided, 'from_block' will be used.

Get transfers up until this date (format in seconds or datestring accepted by momentjs)
* Provide the param 'to_block' or 'to_date'
* If 'to_date' and 'to_block' are provided, 'to_block' will be used.
The desired page size of the result.
The order of the result, in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC)
The cursor returned in the previous response (used for getting the next page).

variable.description: (Required) The address of the token contract
